grade.answer_reason: Says Thistlewire 0.9 server streams have no flow control and queue without bound unless max_buffered_messages is set (default 0, unlimited), and recommends setting it. Says that at the cap the stream is closed with RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED, so dashboards must reconnect, and notes the source is the 0.9 docs, consistent with the pinned 0.9.4.
